HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

3. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.
   B. Use Qualities Of Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Qualities Of Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities Of Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Say Basic Prayers has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic Prayers.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   D. Say Religious has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use General Etiquette: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say General Etiquette: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Myself [ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Basic Prayers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Qualities Of Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
